dependencyDashboardHeader: Merging does not build an image. Publish a release (vX.Y.Z) and GitHub Actions pushes egeback/ha-tn-reporter to Docker Hub.

packageRules.description: Base images: pin the digest so that security patches to the same tag open a PR
Base images: digest/patch/pin in one PR; minor/major get their own
GitHub Actions only affect CI, never the image. The Python version in setup-python follows the Dockerfile's base image.
App dependencies: non-major in one PR; they need a release to reach production
